shell.subtitleReady: Everything a customer needs is in place. Review and publish when you like.
shell.subtitleIncomplete: A few steps and customers can book you. You can leave and come back — nothing is lost.

create.title: Set up your business
create.description: Create your organization and its first location. We'll walk through the rest — services, hours and your public page — straight afterwards.
create.slugHint: Used in your public booking URL. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
create.slugTaken: That URL is already taken — try another.
create.locationHint: e.g. "Bastille" — or your business name if you only have one address.

errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens only, e.g. "le-fade-parisien"

type.title: What kind of business do you run?
type.description: This shapes the rest of setup — which services we suggest, and whether we ask about a team. You can change it later.

solo_professional.label: Solo professional
solo_professional.hint: You work on your own — barber, stylist, colorist, braider.

barbershop.label: Barbershop
barbershop.hint: A shop with a team of barbers.

hair_salon.label: Hair salon
hair_salon.hint: A salon focused on cutting, colour and styling.

mixed_salon.label: Mixed salon
mixed_salon.hint: Barbering and salon services under one roof.

identity.title: How should customers see your name?
identity.description: This is the name on your public page and in search results.

location.title: Where do you work?
location.description: Customers search by city, so this is what makes you findable. It appears on your public page.
location.nameHint: What you call this address internally, e.g. "Bastille".
location.required: A street address and city are required — customers search by city.
location.missingDescription: Something went wrong — your organization has no location yet.
location.missingBody: No location exists for this business. Create one in Locations, then come back to finish setup.

locale.title: Country, currency and timezone
locale.description: The timezone decides what time a slot actually means, so it matters more than it looks. The currency is what every price you set is quoted in.
locale.currencyHint: Suggested from your country. Change it if that isn't right — every price you set is quoted in it.
locale.currencyRequired: Choose a currency — every price you set is quoted in it.

services.title: What do you offer?
services.description: A starting point, not a final list. Rename anything, change the prices and durations, and add your own — all of it stays editable in Services afterwards.
services.priceHint: In whole units of your currency.
services.pickOne: Pick at least one service. You can add more, and edit all of them, later.

professional.title: Who takes clients?
professional.description: At least one bookable professional is needed before anyone can book. If you work yourself, that is you.
professional.nameLabel: Your name as customers see it
professional.nameRequired: A name is required — this is what customers see.
professional.teamBody: Invite them from the Team screen whenever you like — you do not need them here to finish setup.

hours.title: When are you open?
hours.description: Your shop's opening hours. A professional's own hours are set next, and a customer can only book where the two overlap.
hours.oneWindowNote: One opening window per day for now. A midday closure needs a second window, which is a change we have not made yet — set the full span here and block the break in Availability.
hours.allClosed: At least one day needs to be open.

proHours.title: When do you work?
proHours.description: Your own hours, which can be narrower than the shop's. Slots appear only where your hours and the shop's overlap.

profile.title: Your public page
profile.description: What a customer reads before booking. Short is fine — you can rewrite it any time.
profile.displayNameHint: Leave blank to keep what you already have.
profile.aboutHint: Optional. A couple of sentences about how you work.
profile.photosNote: Photos come later — FadeUp has no image storage for shop or portfolio pictures yet, so we are not pretending to ask for them.

review.descriptionReady: Everything a booking needs is in place. Publishing also lists you in marketplace search.
review.descriptionAlmost: These are the pieces still missing. Each one links to the step that fixes it.
review.stillMissing: Still a few things missing — see the list below.
review.bookableNotPublished: You can take bookings from your own link now. Publishing to marketplace search needs the remaining items above.

requirements.location_address: Add a street address and city
requirements.service_at_location: Offer a service at your location
requirements.service_for_professional: Let a professional perform a service
